subject: general
question: Which is the world's largest PV Solar Park located in one of the Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadla Solar Park**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhadla Solar Park** is the world's largest **photovoltaic (PV) solar park**.
 
• It is located in the Indian state of **Rajasthan**.
 
• The park covers an area of approximately **14,000 acres**.
 
• It has a total installed capacity of around **2,245 MW**.
 
• The project has been developed in multiple phases and is a significant step towards India's renewable energy goals.
 
• The solar park is located in Bhadla village in Jodhpur district.
 
• It has contributed significantly to India's national grid and helps in reducing carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar energy** is a crucial part of India's strategy to combat climate change and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
 
• India aims to achieve **175 GW** of renewable energy capacity by 2022, with solar power contributing **100 GW**.
 
• The development of large-scale solar parks like Bhadla is instrumental in achieving these targets.
 
• Rajasthan, with its vast arid land and high solar insolation, is an ideal location for solar power projects.
 
• The Bhadla Solar Park has attracted investments from several major companies and has created numerous job opportunities in the region.
